name: Lexington Summer Sports Clinics and Classes
description_short: Town-run summer sports clinics in Lexington, MA, open to all ability levels. They include the Minuteman Sports Clinics (badminton, basketball, flag football, golf, multi-sports, track, volleyball), the Blue Sox Baseball Camp, a Youth Summer Tennis Clinic for ages 7-13, and weekly USTA Tennis in the Parks lessons.

warnings: This page gives an overview of several separate town recreation programs, not a single camp. Dates, prices and ages are on the individual registration pages on lexrecma.myrec.com.
No season year, dates or prices appear on the page, so it may describe a past summer (2026 or earlier). Season year left blank.
Each program focuses on one sport, so camp_type is set to 'specialty'. These are almost certainly day programs, but the page does not say so.
The phone number (781-698-4800) and the 39 Marrett Road address belong to the Recreation Department office, not necessarily the program locations.
